study_type: Exploratory post-hoc alpha-selection follow-up; one seed; not confirmatory.
relationship_to_prior_run: Post-hoc follow-up prompted by the prior one-seed adapter run failing all four utility gates. This is diagnostic, not confirmatory, and does not change the prior result.
research_question: Can a stronger retain-NLL weight reduce utility damage from the previous 3B NPO-LoRA setup while preserving measurable forgetting on separate TOFU author-profile cohorts?

limitations: TOFU profile blocks are inferred from contiguous groups of 20 rows because the published files do not expose a structured author ID.
The published full checkpoint was already fine-tuned on the TOFU training data; this protocol measures adapter effects relative to that checkpoint.
This follow-up uses a subset of the benchmark and is not a standard full-split TOFU leaderboard run.

selection.rule: Run candidates in ascending alpha_retain order and stop at the first candidate satisfying every development gate. If none passes, stop without running the final cohort.

development_gates.forget10.truth_ratio_score: lower bound of paired profile-block bootstrap 95% CI for candidate minus full checkpoint must be > 0
development_gates.forget10.answer_probability: upper bound of paired profile-block bootstrap 95% CI for candidate minus full checkpoint must be < 0
development_gates.retain90.answer_probability: lower bound of paired profile-block bootstrap 95% CI for candidate minus full checkpoint must be > -0.05
development_gates.retain90.rougeL_recall: lower bound of paired profile-block bootstrap 95% CI for candidate minus full checkpoint must be > -0.05
development_gates.holdout10.answer_probability: lower bound of paired profile-block bootstrap 95% CI for candidate minus full checkpoint must be > -0.05

selection.final_gates: Apply the same five gates once to the disjoint final profile cohorts. No threshold changes after development results are observed.

bootstrap.unit: profile block, paired by source row index

training.method: NPO forget objective plus weighted retain token-mean NLL, LoRA adapters only
training.precision: FP16 frozen base checkpoint; FP32 LoRA parameters and loss; SDPA
training.retain_sampling: uniform with replacement from optimizer-only retain profiles; seed 42
training.hardware: Kaggle T4 x2 only; no CPU/disk offload; FP16 frozen base, FP32 LoRA and loss; SDPA

evaluation.research_claim_limit: One-seed exploratory diagnostic; final cohort is held out from alpha selection, but the result is not confirmatory.

stopping_rules: Verify the pinned data hashes, row counts, profile assignments, and all disjointness checks before loading model weights.
Verify the exact pinned NPO objective value and gradients before GPU training.
Run candidates sequentially and stop at the first candidate that passes every development gate.
If no candidate passes, do not run final-cohort training and report the negative development result.
If a candidate passes development, run one final-cohort training/evaluation with its selected alpha and unchanged settings.
Any runtime failure preserves logs and receipts; do not interpret a partial run as a research result.
